scope.description: Fictional examples for learning the format. All organisations, requests, dates and budgets are invented. These are not live opportunities. Example content is dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/.

demand.name: Paid developer: repair access pages
demand.description: Fictional request to replace three outdated pages with approved access information.

terms.intendedResult: Visitors can find current access information.
terms.scope: Three static pages and a staff editing guide.

response.statement: In this fictional example, send a scope proposal through the form.

effort.basis: Fictional publisher estimate for the whole scope

workLocation.statement: Working-location eligibility is agreed before work starts.

language.statement: Pages and handover are in English.

rights.statement: Agree rights to the work before starting.

maintenance.statement: Staff maintains the pages after handover.

terms.handover: Deliver source files and the editing guide. Later development needs a separate agreement.

compensation.statement: Fictional paid scope. Agree the fee and invoice terms before work starts.

budgets.statement: Fictional declared fee range; final fee depends on the agreed scope.
Fictional hosting budget, paid directly to the provider. Separate from contributor pay.

demand.name: Pro bono designer: make an access leaflet
demand.description: Fictional request for a readable two-page leaflet using approved text.

terms.intendedResult: Visitors can use a clear printed access guide.
terms.scope: One two-page leaflet, editable files and one revision.

effort.basis: Fictional publisher estimate including one revision

compensation.statement: This fictional design scope is unpaid. The organisation pays printing separately.

budgets.statement: Fictional payment to a printer; this is not a design fee.

demand.name: Paid campaign support: explain a local service
demand.description: Fictional request to plan and run a short public-information campaign.

terms.intendedResult: Residents understand how to access the service.
terms.scope: One campaign plan, three approved messages and a delivery report.

compensation.statement: Fictional hourly pay for all agreed campaign work, up to 20 hours. Campaign spend is separate.

budgets.basis: Each agreed hour, up to 20 hours
budgets.statement: Fictional contributor rate. No total fee is stated.
Fictional media budget, paid directly to media providers. Separate from contributor pay.
Fictional software budget, paid directly to the provider.

demand.name: Expenses-only access walkthrough
demand.description: Fictional request to review a public visitor route with staff.

terms.intendedResult: Staff receives a list of access barriers to investigate.
terms.scope: One walkthrough and a short written account.

workLocation.statement: At the fictional community centre. Agree access needs before attending.

compensation.statement: No fee for time. Reimburse agreed travel costs against receipts, up to the declared cap.

budgets.basis: Agreed return travel for one walkthrough
budgets.statement: Fictional reimbursement cap. This pays expenses, not labour.

demand.name: Archive help: terms unknown
demand.description: Fictional early request to improve a public document archive. Scope and acceptance terms remain unspecified.

response.statement: No response route is declared in this fictional example.

compensation.statement: Payment terms remain unknown. Missing amounts do not mean unpaid work.

budgets.statement: Fictional budget placeholder. Amount and available funds are unknown.

notes.text: This request is an early outline; confirm the scope and terms before considering work.

demand.name: Filled: translate an access guide
demand.description: Fictional historical request retained to show a filled need.

terms.intendedResult: Visitors can read the guide in Spanish.

response.statement: The fictional role is filled. No further responses are accepted.

effort.basis: Fictional estimate for the original request

compensation.statement: A fictional fixed fee was committed to the selected contributor. It is no longer available to new contributors.

budgets.statement: Fictional historical fee, already committed to the selected contributor.
